description: Simplified 14-Generator Australian Power System is a grid model dataset listed in Awesome Grid Model Data, a curated list of electricity grid model datasets under the section "PowerWorld (`.pwb/.pwd`) > Small Signal Stability Test Cases", published or maintained by Small Signal Stability Test Cases. Australian equivalent system. Coverage: the power system named in the entry. The list files it under Small Signal Stability Test Cases and gives it in PowerWorld, PSSE, PSLF, MATPOWER formats, with 2 links. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-flow, dynamic-stability and production-cost model studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-grid-model-data.
